# Prefixed stream import dispatch — #1740

The seven `original*.ts` files preserve all issue programs. Fresh unchanged
main and pre-repair current retain the named node:stream failure: from/typed/
push programs cleanly print nothing, catch prints the undefined-function
TypeError, and stage stops before after-from. The bare from control prints 6.
Each executable saved reproduction verifies IL and finishes within the original
30 seconds with empty stderr. The top-level-await original remains rejected
before emission; its unchanged diagnostic is retained as a control limitation.

Seven executable references pass in both engines and as isolated saved
standalone outputs, including the six unchanged executable originals and a
bare construction/push control. Saved execution requires verified IL, exact
Node stdout, empty stderr, clean exit within 30 seconds and no SharpTS
reference/copy. Node checks all eight sources, including the await limitation;
the SharpTS limitation is excluded from passing execution counts.

The compiler pre-scan strips node: before registering built-in bindings, so
function bodies receive the same canonical emitter key as module resolution.
Shared state-machine method dispatch also resolves dynamic receiver methods
instead of selecting an array operation solely from names such as push. This
preserves Readable.push, its null EOF signal and subsequent async iteration.

No iterator-next, Windows process-lifetime or hosted guest execution repair is
claimed. The historical matching-body observations remain evidence of the
earlier migration; this semantic repair changes emitted method bodies.
